cases.why: Real message, shape and all: a dotted account number, the amount on its own line with only a minus sign to give it a direction, a date with an underscore in it, and a مانده that names no unit. The sign is the direction; the مانده is still the balance.

body: *بانك ياساركاد* كارمزد پيامك بانكي 6 ماهه دوم سال 1400 برداشت از: 1503.8000.11222610.1 مبلغ: 75,000 ريال 00/12/17_16:43 موجودي: 154,874 ريال
cases.why: A different shape from the bare-figure one: موجودی rather than مانده, a dotted account number, the whole thing on one line, and both figures naming ریال outright. برداشت and کارمزد both say which way the money went.
